about: The Preface of the Apostles. It asks the eternal Shepherd not to forsake His flock, but to preserve it under the protection of the Apostles and their successors.

seg.nr: Then the priest separates his hands and holds them apart until the end of the Preface. When it is finished, he joins them again and, bowing, says: Sanctus.

seg.tr: It is truly meet and just, right and profitable for salvation:
To entreat Thee humbly, O Lord, that Thou, eternal Shepherd, wouldst not forsake Thy flock, but through Thy blessed Apostles wouldst keep it under constant protection:
That it may be governed by those same rulers whom Thou didst appoint over it as pastors and vicars of Thy work.
And therefore with Angels and Archangels, with Thrones and Dominions, and with all the hosts of the heavenly army, we sing the hymn of Thy glory, evermore saying:
